cells.gaps: No share or count of primary clinics entering their own reports is published: TZA-040 and TZA-043 say some facilities enter directly with no figure, the only clinics row (TZA-017, none) is a 2017 sample of 16 facilities and does not carry the country, and TZA-037 (facility, over 75% of 27 sampled facilities, no dispensaries) disagrees with TZA-023 (council-level entry for 11,805 facilities) for 2024. Tiers rest on a 2019 fact; finance is not stated inside 36 months (TZA-012, donor, is 2022); HSSP V, the plan TZA-035 cites, ran to June 2026 by TZA-011 and no successor period is given; the advancing event (TZA-022) is Zanzibar's ZHMIS on a proxy date. The Zanzibar validation workshop of 1 October 2025 has passed out of the twelve months, and no later dated event is held.
cells.note: The ministry's own 2024 methodology has facilities aggregating on paper and councils keying into DHIS2, which is stage 3's whole row. Stage 4 needs entry at the facility by more than half of primary clinics on a figure with a denominator, and none is held.

cells.gaps: Nothing says where the record is digitised or whether it is retrievable at another facility: the only admitted digitised rows are paper (TZA-018, a 2017 sample; TZA-047, 2019), which the later tiers rows contradict, and TZA-007's integrated system carries no facility count. The clinics share is SARA 2023's 23.25% of all facilities read as primary clinics (10.6% of dispensaries, 44.9% of health centres); the newest rows give no share (TZA-002) or a count of more than 3,000 with no denominator (TZA-028). Finance is not stated; vendor systems run in zonal and specialised hospitals (TZA-033); the Digital Health Strategy ran out in 2024 and HSSP V in June 2026 with the successor still in development (TZA-034); no dated event falls inside the twelve months, and no named community system is shown exchanging with the EMR.
cells.note: Electronic records are reported in all referral and regional hospitals and in a minority of primary facilities, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary clinics on a shared record, and the latest share is 23.25% with no fact establishing a shared record.
